name: Phase gadget from CNOTs
summary: A Z-rotation on the target, conjugated by CNOTs, is a two-qubit phase gadget.
description:
The circuit consisting of a CNOT, a Z-phase α on the target, and the same CNOT again implements the diagonal unitary $|x_1x_2\rangle \mapsto e^{i\alpha(x_1\oplus x_2)}|x_1x_2\rangle$, i.e. $e^{-i\frac\alpha2 Z\otimes Z}$ up to global phase. In the ZX-calculus it is the two-qubit *phase gadget*: a phase-free X-spider connected to both qubits and to a Z-spider with phase α. The proof uses spider fusion and the [bialgebra rule](../bialgebra/).

For more qubits, a phase gadget on n qubits is a ladder of CNOTs computing the parity, a phase, and the reversed ladder. The ZX form makes the symmetry between the qubits manifest.
